policy.target: synthetic in-memory only; empty child environment; no API/DB/network
policy.setup: one fixture and one index per measured group; separate full scan/index verification group
policy.memory: input retained; RSS includes snapshots, indexes, answers and normal GC; no forced GC
policy.first: first in group is fresh process, not guaranteed cold OS/runtime; later queries share warm state
policy.repeats: queries inside a group are dependent; independent preparations are group-level repeats
policy.order: normal, reverse, rotate by two across three main preparations
policy.stops: step 30s; worker 120s; RSS 6GiB; owner 256MiB; window 20min; output 10MiB; first error stops
policy.admission: prior same-family/density/catalog-size group x item-count ratio x1.25; startup step fixed x1.25, whole job conservatively scaled; RSS<=4GiB, step<=20s, job<=100s; estimate not guarantee
policy.completeness: full scan/index answers; matching input digest; no top-N; one page of 20 items
